SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_score
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
) sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
ORDER BY sat.avg_sat_score DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_score
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
) sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
ORDER BY sat.avg_sat_score DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS AvgSATScore
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
) sub ON s.CDSCode = sub.cds
ORDER BY sub.AvgSATScore DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT CDSCode, AVG(AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_score
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY CDSCode
    ORDER BY avg_sat_score DESC
    LIMIT 3
) t ON s.CDSCode = t.CDSCode;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT CDSCode, AVG(AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite) AS avg_sat_score
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY CDSCode
) ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.CDSCode
ORDER BY ss.avg_sat_score DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.School = ss.sname
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
ORDER BY (ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrWrite) / 3 DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
ORDER BY (ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrWrite) / 3 DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.School = ss.sname
ORDER BY AVG(ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrWrite) DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 3;
